## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): strong multi-tone SdH on both carrier signs

Raw traces + tone inventory (`sdh_onset`, `sdh_fft`) for the two spot checks (run 6: electron, n = +3.2×10¹², B 0→10 T; run 7: hole, n = −1.2×10¹², 10→0.3 T; both sr1 50 µV, run-5 calibration). **Read:**

- **Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T):** dominant light tone **F ≈ 7.1 T** (21 % of F_L), oscillating from below the 0.3 T record edge (onset censored) with a clean harmonic ladder 2×/3×/4× (14.1 / 22.2 / 29.5 T, SNR 50–100). Extra low-F content at 3.0 / 4.2 / 5.2 T (censored at the edge; candidates: region-B mosaic at ×1.13 n, spin/valley splitting of the light band, or beats). The light band carries only ~0.7×10¹² of the 3.2×10¹² total — the rest must sit in a heavier FS whose fundamental (ABAB two-band model predicts ≈ 25.6 T) is **not separable from the 3–4× harmonics of 7.1 T at the spot's 4.3 T FFT resolution**. Consistent with a light+heavy two-band structure (ABAB-like), but not yet a call.
- **Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T):** rich multi-tone set (4.7 / 6.6 / 8.5 / 12.3 T fundamentals + harmonics; strongest 12.3 T ≈ F_L), non-marginal fundamental sum ≈ 26 T ≈ 2×F_L — over-complete, the expected low-|n| semimetal/mixing regime; not decisive by itself.

**Verdict:** device shows textbook SdH (onsets 0.3–0.7 T, tones tracked to ~30 T) at T_e ≈ 8 K — a Landau fan is well-conditioned. The stacking call needs the tone *dispersion vs n*: fundamentals move with n, harmonics stay locked at integer multiples of their parent, and the two-band partition F_light(n) + F_heavy(n) = F_L(n) (or its failure) is the ABAB/ABCA/ABCB discriminator. → next: `landau-fan` along D = 0.

# Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks (raw first, then tones)
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

R_FS_SPOT = 50e-6 / 10e-9   # sr1 50 uV at 10 nA -> 5 kOhm full scale
onsets = {}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for k, (rid, side, n12) in enumerate([(6, "electron", +3.2), (7, "hole", -1.2)]):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6                 # measured drain current, A
    R = np.abs(r.col("sr1_X") / I)            # 4-probe Rxx (sr1 gain 1)
    order = np.argsort(B)
    B, R = B[order], R[order]
    F_L = luttinger_frequency(n12 * 1e16)     # full-density Onsager freq, T
    print(f"\n=== run {rid} ({side}, n = {n12:+.2f}e12, F_L = {F_L:.1f} T) === "
          f"rows {r.rows}, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, R {R.min():.1f}-{R.max():.1f} Ohm")
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=R_FS_SPOT)
        print(on.summary())
        onsets[rid] = on
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"sdh_onset FAILED: {e}")
        on = None
    # FFT in 1/B over the 3-10 T window (dF = 1/(1/3 - 1/10) = 4.3 T -- spot resolution)
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(3.0, B.max()), nfft=2048, log=False)
    axes[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    axes[k, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); axes[k, 0].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    axes[k, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} {side}: n = {n12:+.2f}e12, D = 0 — raw Rxx(B)")
    axes[k, 1].plot(freqs, spec[0], lw=0.8)
    axes[k, 1].axvline(F_L, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {F_L:.1f} T")
    if on is not None:
        for t in on.tones:
            axes[k, 1].axvline(t.freq, color="0.6" if (t.marginal or t.harmonic_of) else "g", ls=":", lw=1)
    axes[k, 1].set_xlim(0, 1.6 * F_L)
    axes[k, 1].set_xlabel("F (T)"); axes[k, 1].set_ylabel("FFT mag (3-10 T window)")
    axes[k, 1].legend(fontsize=8); axes[k, 1].set_title("FFT in 1/B (green = fundamental, grey = harmonic/marginal)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan along D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking discriminator

> **05:26** · landau-fan: n fast [-1.25,+3.25]e12 91 pts (0.05e12) co-swept (TG,BG) on run-5 D=0 line; B slow 1->10 T uniform-1/B 140 rows (F\_Nyq 77 T, dF 1.11 T); sr1 200 uV (20 kOhm FS); ends 10 T, gates park 0 · **ETA ~11:26** (≈6h)

Plan step 4 (operator-requested next move). Runs 6/7 (ana cells 14–15) show textbook SdH on both carrier signs but the spot FFT resolution (dF ≈ 4.3 T) cannot separate the candidate ABAB heavy fundamental (≈ 25.6 T at n = +3.2×10¹²) from the 3–4× harmonics of the dominant 7.1 T light tone. The fan resolves this three ways: fundamentals **disperse with n** while harmonics stay integer-locked to their parent; the branch **partition ΣFᵢ(n) vs F_L(n) = 10.34·n[10¹²] T** distinguishes two-band ABAB (sum rule) from single-branch ABCA from an asymmetric/gapped ABCB; and the **CNP column R(B)** reads the D = 0 gap. Region-B mosaic tones (+13 % n, run 5) are a known contaminant to check per column.

**Design.** Fast axis: n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² in 0.05 steps (91 pts), (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept on the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line — spans the full validator-allowed window, both carrier signs (nothing excluded; the hole side simply ends at the TG −0.3 V limit). Slow axis: B = 1 → 10 T **uniform in 1/B**, 140 rows (Δ(1/B) = 6.5×10⁻³ → F_Nyq = 77 T ≈ 2× the highest observed content; per-column FFT dF = 1.11 T separates 25.6 T from 28.4 T). Ascending from the magnet's current 0 T (never re-traverse); ends at **10 T** with gates parked at 0. Below-1 T content (run-6 light-tone onset ≤ 0.3 T) is traded out: covering 0.5–1 T at this Nyquist doubles the row count (~+4 h) and adds onset/mass information, not frequency-structure information. sr1 fixed at 200 µV (20 kΩ FS): sized to the unknown CNP column at high B; a rail there is accepted and is itself a gap statement.

**Price** (calibrated on run 5: 1.10 s/pt in-row at fast_delay 1.0, ~6 s turnaround): 140 × (91 × 1.10 + 9) s ≈ 4.2 h in-row + 66 min ramps (9 T at 0.137 T/min) + 7 min initial 0→1 T ≈ 5.6 h → quoted **6 h** (session actuals run over the bracket). **Checkpoints:** first rows (~12 min in: signal, leakage, sensitivity, B tracking); then at ~2 T (row ~78, ≈ 2.7 h) and ~4 T (row ~117, ≈ 4.3 h) — partial per-column FFT on landed rows: are branches dispersing with n? continue / abandon call at each (abort ≈ `nb-collab interrupt`, partial fan keeps its data). hera-watch armed on the run dir.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`): n fast along D = 0 [-1.25, +3.25]e12 (91 pts), B slow 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (140 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.arange(-1.25, 3.2501, 0.05)              # 1e12 cm^-2, 91 pts along D = 0
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 140)                  # uniform in 1/B: d(1/B) = 6.5e-3 -> F_Nyq = 77 T; FFT dF = 1.11 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 0.99
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"fan: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 x B {B_vec[0]:.2f}..{B_vec[-1]:.2f} T ({len(n_vec)} x {len(B_vec)}); "
      f"Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}], Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}]")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts with the 0->1 T ramp), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Sized to the unknown CNP
# column at high B (gatemap lesson, run 4: the extreme feature sets R_max, not the 1D peaks);
# branch oscillations at 50-600 Ohm sit at 0.25-3 % FS, fine for the FFT. If the D = 0 CNP
# gap exceeds 20 kOhm at high B that column rails -- accepted and itself a gap read (R >= FS).
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (20 kOhm FS); "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan: n fast -1.25..+3.25e12 (91, 0.05e12) co-swept (TG,BG) on the run-5 D=0 line; "
                  "B slow 1->10 T uniform-1/B (140); sr1 200 uV; ends 10 T, gates park at 0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'n fast [-1.25, +3.25]e12 91 pts (0.05e12) along D = 0 (co-swept Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, '
              f'Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f}); B slow 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B 140 rows (F_Nyq 77 T, dF 1.11 T); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)   # gates park at 0; field stays at 10 T for the next step
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
